scene: Lowering your brass telescope, you spot three peculiar rooftop departures preparing nearby.
picture: Flat side view on the flat rooftop edge under night stars. On the far left, a suspended window-cleaner gondola hangs with its gate open. Left of centre, the player stands holding his brass telescope. In the centre, a tiny mail train puffs steam. On the far right, a hover tow truck idles.
shown: a yellow window-cleaner gondola swinging from a steel cable far left
a miniature brass-and-green mail train idling at the centre platform
a bright pink sky-crane tow truck idling on the far right
